facts.fact: Vedra 与 Liam 在次日近午抵达 Silverway，Vedra 先骑马前行探路，穿过营地仍骑在鞍上。
facts.anchor: Vedra and Liam reached the Silverway

facts.fact: 有东西从树上落到她鞍后，一只手捂住她的嘴，压低声音说自己正是 Cerball。
Cerball 说 Crows 没看到 Daley 一行被俘的迹象，但 Scaeth 已带重兵等在谷口，雇佣兵当天在备盾磨枪、准备开战。
facts.anchor: Scaeth was waiting at the valley mouth in force

facts.fact: 营地里 Tika 与另一名女 Crow 剥开 Xaniko 的上衣查看伤口，露出凝固的血，Vedra 反胃。
Diarban 给 Daley 讲 Flann 早年被逐出家族土地、退入 Circoille 大森林的旧事。
facts.anchor: Flann had first been driven from his family lands

facts.fact: 故事里第一支箭劈断绞绳、农民摔在绞架上，第二支箭劈断吊招牌的绳，坠下的木手砸死了 Caolan Hardfist。
facts.anchor: split the hanging rope in two

facts.fact: Flann 改射草原兵队长 Hrinvart Firemouth，箭中咽喉，草原兵随即冲过 Silverway。
facts.anchor: lodged in his throat, silencing him in mid-shout

facts.fact: Flann 派 Cerball 回营传令：若自己与 Tynon 天黑未归，众人撤往沼泽、西岸与 Greenwrack。
facts.anchor: we will try to meet you at Ach Uafas
